answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tide. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
